subject: In-game Liberty cityscape, full-profile supplemental roughness and metallic maps
result: After preserving room vertex lighting and handling backface normals in the PBR shader, the full-profile PBR-on capture keeps the broad city facades visibly lit; the earlier near-black facade regression is not present in this A/B. Both PBR-off and PBR-on Release runs reached Mission_01a base enter without the prior surface-map lease crash. This validates the specific regressions, not overall PBR material quality.

conditions.data: 13 active NAP packages built from Data/NAP; manifest lancer-pbr-qa-20261014; archive sizes and SHA-256 hashes checked immediately before launch; no loose DATA directory
conditions.save: Mission_01a base scene; off/on save copies had identical SHA-256 b6bf5fca41fc1e9e6e38b713af45df9137ae7f7de8077a514fde15d8ef975524
conditions.camera: Same saved base/cityscape entry and camera framing; traffic and sky animation advanced between captures.
conditions.runs: Fresh sequential PBR-off and PBR-on launches of the same Release build; both reached Mission_01a base enter. The screenshot pair uses the same save copy and camera framing; traffic and sky animation advanced between captures.
conditions.pbrLighting: PBR shader carries room vertex diffuse/ambient terms and flips backface normals to match legacy Basic lighting.

measurement.note: Sequential captures include moving ships, sky and UI; the pixel difference is not a same-frame attribution. Visual inspection shows no broad near-black city facades in the PBR-on capture.

leaseCrash.beforeFix: Full-profile PBR-on launch crashed in Cutscene.Draw/SystemRenderer.Draw with Surface PBR map lease was not released after the preceding draw.
leaseCrash.fix: VisualMesh.DrawImmediate now invokes RenderMaterial.AfterDraw from a finally block around Use and the immediate draw.
leaseCrash.afterFix: Fresh PBR-off and PBR-on full-profile Release runs both loaded UI and reached Mission_01a base enter; neither current run log contains the lease-crash message.

openFinding: The metallic PBR path still lacks IBL/environment reflections. Validate material fidelity in ship, station, planet and effect scenes; no performance acceptance has been done.

lightingFix.cause: The PBR path did not carry RoomGameplay vertex diffuse/ambient lighting and did not invert normals for backfaces.
lightingFix.fix: Enable the PBR VERTEX_LIGHTING feature when RenderMaterial.VertexLighting is set, pass front/back diffuse and ambient terms, and select the correct normal using SV_IsFrontFace.
lightingFix.observed: The PBR-on Liberty cityscape no longer shows the broad near-black facade regression in the sequential full-profile A/B.
lightingFix.remaining: This does not add IBL/environment reflections; PBR material fidelity and performance remain open.
